lines.text: Look at the scar on its throat—that glowing iron! Someone harpooned this monster before us!
lines.journalNote: Isha saw a Tide Glow harpoon head lodged deep inside the Makara's armored gullet.

lines.text: Powder's dry. Guns are lashed. If the sea wants a fight, port broadside is ready to answer.
lines.journalNote: Gunner Isha stands vigilant by the port battery, smelling of sulfur and sea salt.

lines.text: Kedar's hounds are prowling. Let them try the guns—they'll get a rammer through the teeth.
lines.journalNote: Isha suspects the crew is turning, but she holds her battery against all comers.

lines.text: Thorne's dead in his cabin. Mutineers everywhere. But I won't abandon my cannons for a traitor's flag.
lines.journalNote: Isha refuses to swear loyalty to Kedar. She stays glued to the port broadside.

lines.text: Feel that vibration in the deck? It's coming from under the cargo grating. Not engine, not bilge. Something older.
lines.journalNote: Isha feels the Kaal Mani humming through the ship's timbers beneath the hold hatch.

lines.text: If we come about hard to port, I can bring all four cannons to bear on the monster. But someone has to hold the helm plate steady.
lines.journalNote: Isha says she can drive off the Leviathan if the helm plate is held steady while she fires.

lines.text: Keep her steady into the wind, Navigator. If you give me a level deck, my guns will tear anything out of the water.
lines.journalNote: Isha needs the Navigator to keep the ship level so her port cannons can hold their aim.

lines.text: Quartermaster, don't skimp on my powder measures. When the sea starts boiling, I don't want damp cartridges in my magazines.
lines.journalNote: Isha bluntly demanded full dry powder rations from the Quartermaster.

lines.text: Clear the recoil tracks, deckhand! One step wrong when the 18-pounder kicks and you're pulp.
lines.journalNote: Isha barked at me to mind the gun tackle. A stern warning about cannon recoil.

lines.text: You keep scanning the port water like you're tracking a shadow. My guns are primed for whatever surfaces.
lines.journalNote: Isha noticed my attention on the port swells, readying her guns.

lines.text: There's a strange chime vibrating in the planking... almost sounds like chanting from the deep.
lines.journalNote: Isha felt the humming resonance in the ship's timbers.
